measures:
HOW THE GATE MEASURES — build to these definitions exactly

  Every run is headless (SDL_VIDEODRIVER=dummy, SDL_AUDIODRIVER=dummy) at seed 7 (and identically at one undisclosed seed), in a FRESH EMPTY working directory: the gate calls gilded.settings.settings_path() and gilded.save.quicksave_path() there and deletes both first, and it deletes a game-named file ONLY if that file's directory is the block's temp working directory (otherwise every line of the block FAILS with "... escapes the working directory: <path>"). A launch is pygame.display.quit() then gilded.ui.app.new_app_state(seed=7, start="menu" or "game"). A draw is widgets.take_text_rows(), view.regions.clear(), view.draw(<the live display surface>); the drawn regions are view.regions._regions and the drawn text is widgets._text_rows (blit_text records one row per call) — every fact's HOME below must be drawn through blit_text (or appended to widgets._text_rows). The gate ALSO records every string any font's render() produces during a draw (it installs a recording pygame.font.Font and clears widgets._font_cache before its first draw): text the game renders through any font's render() — font.render + surface.blit outside blit_text included — ALSO counts when the census looks for a SECOND home or a fog leak (C10.1b, C10.2a, C10.2b, C10.5). A fact drawn outside blit_text cannot be the home, and it can still be the leak. A LINE is the text rows whose centre-y lie within 6 px of each other, joined left to right with spaces (a table row is one line). A press is: the region must be the top region at its centre (view.regions.at(centre)), view.handle_click(centre), and if that returns a dict, gilded.ui.app._apply_action(state, that dict); None means the view handled the press itself. Families are the seven of gilded.agenda.FAMILIES: Conquest, Dominion, Buyout, Dynasty, Intrigue, Glory, Consolidation; a family is matched as a whole word in any letter case.

  THE CENSUS (used by C10.1b, C10.2a, C10.2b, C10.5): every screen the play view can show — for each spine in gilded.ui.broadsheet.TABS, every page in view.house_pages (House) / view.powers_pages (Powers) — PLUS every page named by a drawn {"tab": T} or {"set_spine_page": P} region on any screen (so an inner page reached by a button counts). The gate sets view.active_tab / view.house_page / view.powers_page and draws; Powers pages are drawn once with view._powers_selected = None and once with each rival selected. A screen is named "House/<page>", "Powers/<page>" or "Atlas". Pickers stay closed; the HUD strip and the bottom bar are part of EVERY screen they are drawn on.

  C10.1a.ambition-chosen: launch start="menu", press the drawn {"menu": "new_game"} region, draw once: that FIRST screen after New Game must draw regions whose actions name all seven families (a value equal to the family string anywhere in the action dict, e.g. {"set_ambition": {"family": "Dynasty"}, ...}). Press one family's region: state.game must be in play at turn 1 with game.ambitions.status(state.house)["family"] AND game.agendas[state.house].family both equal to the pressed family. This is done in two launches with two different families (the seed picks them), and in the first launch the gate then calls game.end_turn() up to 12 times: game.ambitions.status(house)["fulfilled"] must become True or False — the pressed family is a live stake set through game.ambitions.set_ambition (snapshot and all), which the sim resolves at the close of its 10-turn window; a Goal written straight into game.agendas never resolves and FAILS.

  C10.1b.ambition-shown-once: after the second launch's press, census every screen: the player's ambition family must be drawn on exactly ONE screen, and that screen must be a House screen (the Court in Session). No other screen — Overview buttons, Powers, Atlas, the HUD — may draw the family word.

  C10.2a.rank-public: launch start="game", the gate sets the stake through game.ambitions.set_ambition(house, "Consolidation"), then presses the drawn {"end_turn": True} region twice (each press must advance game.turn). Census: exactly one screen must draw EVERY house's ladder entry at the rank game.ladder() gives it, where an entry is a LINE containing the rank token followed by the house name: "<r>. House <h>" or "#<r> <h>" (e.g. "4. House Ashworth (you)", "#1 Karsgate"). No other screen may draw the player's rank — in its lines or in any rendered string — in any of these forms (any letter case): an entry for the player's house; "rank <r>" / "Rank #<r>"; "<r>th"-style digit ordinals ("4th"); "<r> of 7" / "<r>/7"; a spelled ordinal or cardinal of seven ("fourth of seven", "four of seven", "4th of seven"); or the words rank / ranked / ladder / place / position / stand / stands followed within four non-word characters by <r>, "#<r>" or the spelled ordinal ("You stand fourth", "ladder #4", "ranked 4", "place 4"). "standing" is an axis name and is NOT a rank word. (The HUD's "Rank #" goes.) The gate then moves the player's sim rank (treasury to 0 if rank 1, else +10,000,000), presses End Turn again, censuses again: the one ladder screen must draw every house at its NEW game.ladder() rank, the player's rank must have changed, and it is still drawn nowhere else.

  C10.2b.rank-why-through-fog: launch start="game", set the stake as in C10.2a, call gilded.agenda.ensure_agenda(game, h) for every rival and strip every intel source from the player toward each rival (relations to 0, no marriage tie, no secret on their ruler held by the player's line, no informant) — at turn 1 every rival is then intel tier 0 by gilded.intel.report(game, player, rival).tier. Census (the low state). Then the gate places an informant on the SECOND house of gilded.intel.threat_rank(game) (tier 1) and raises the FIRST to tier 3 through the sim's own sources: an informant in game.informants, a marriage tie tuple (player ruler id, player, their ruler id, them) in game.marriages.marriages, and a Secret on their ruler held by the player's ruler — and censuses again (the raised state). On the ladder screen (the one screen that draws every house's entry), the raised state must draw NEW lines, beyond the low state's, holding each of the four axes of the tier-3 house as "<axis> <number>" (capital, standing, blood, world; the number within 1 of game.ladder()'s value for that house, e.g. "capital 85  standing 50  blood 16  world 100"). And on EVERY screen, in both states, no LINE that belongs to a house at intel tier 0 or 1 (a line belongs to the house whose name appears first in it) may carry an axis word with a number — not the ladder, not the HUD's rival meters, not any rendered string (a rendered string is a line of its own). So a rival's axes are hidden at tiers 0 and 1 and drawn at tier 3 (the gate builds exactly those three states; tier 2 is not graded — choose it yourself); rank alone below that.

  C10.3a.court-in-session: on the House screen C10.1b found (the only screen drawing the ambition), a member card is a drawn region whose action names a living adult (age >= 16) of the player's house by id under the key "portrait", "member" or "char_id" (e.g. {"portrait": "000000a9"}), whose rect overlaps the drawn text rows of that member's stance — exactly one of the words backs / wary / opposes — and of that member's want. At least 4 cards, and EVERY region that draws a stance word must draw the stance game.ambitions.wants(house) gives that member AND the want: the want text wants() gives, minus the leading member name, drawn in full (wrapped across rows is fine, truncated is not) inside the card's rect. Regions that draw no stance word (e.g. a seat portrait) are not cards; when a member has several member regions on the screen, the LARGEST one is that member's card.

  C10.3b.stance-from-dispositions: take a card member X and an adult Y whom wants() gives a different stance; swap their character.dispositions dicts (all 30 values). game.ambitions.wants(house) must now give X the stance Y had and Y the stance X had (the stance is a function of the dispositions and the house ambition ONLY — not of id, name, age, seat or a cache), and on a redraw of the same screen X's card must draw its new stance and its new want (the card's text changes). The gate restores both vectors afterwards. The cards on that screen must not be chosen by stance.

  C10.4.opposing-member-lever: on the same screen a lever is a drawn region whose action has a key containing "lever" and a value that is a member's id (e.g. {"court_lever": "000000b2", "what": ..., "why": ..., "wins": ...}). Levers may be drawn ONLY for members wants() says oppose, and a carded opposing member must have one (if no card opposes, the gate first gives a card member the dispositions of an adult who opposes, then redraws). Pressing that member's lever must leave wants() giving that member a stance other than "opposes"; a member who is gone (no longer a living adult of the house) counts only if one of the player's four ladder axes (game.ladder()) moved with the press. Paying gold, writing a beat or changing the drawn text alone does not count.

  C10.5.rival-agendas-per-fog: in the C10.2b low and raised states: on a Powers screen, a LINE belonging to the tier-3 house must name its agenda family (game.agendas[h].family) in the raised state and no Powers line belonging to it may name it in the low state (tier 0); no line on ANY screen belonging to a house at tier 0 or 1 may name that house's family; and no screen outside the Powers spine may draw MORE lines naming the tier-3 house's family in the raised state than in the low state (the HUD's "Their design: ..." goes — the agenda's one home is Powers).

  C10.6.ending-names-ambition: three games, each launch start="game", game.ambitions.set_ambition(house, F) at turn 1, game.turn set to 70 (TURN_BUDGET), then the drawn End Turn pressed so the century closes (game.game_over set): (1) F = Glory with 10,000,000 added to the treasury; (2) F = Glory with the treasury at 0; (3) F = Dynasty with 10,000,000 added. For each, the sim's own outcome is game.ambitions.status(house)["fulfilled"] (True/False — the stake resolves at its window's close through ambitions.resolve_due); the drawn ending page (view.draw with game_over set) AND gilded.endings.judge(game, house).text must each contain a sentence naming F whose outcome word is exactly one of: fulfilled (True) — or fell short / falls short / failed / unfulfilled / not fulfilled / never fulfilled (False: a negated "fulfilled" reads as fell short), and that outcome must equal the sim's. Game (1) must be fulfilled and (2) must fall short (Glory rides the treasury); (3) follows whatever the sim resolved — an outcome read off the capital axis FAILS it. Put the ambition sentence where the ending page draws it (the overlay stops drawing paragraphs at the bottom of the window).

  C10.7.verbs-self-explain: every new verb carries its explanation: the seven family regions of C10.1a and the lever regions of C10.4. Each carries non-empty strings "what", "why" and "wins" in its action dict (or, for an action key already in gilded.ui.registry.VERBS, that entry's what / why_now / serves); "wins" must name a ladder axis (capital, standing, blood, world) or the word ambition; the "what" AND the "why" must both be DRAWN — on the screen, or in the hover tooltip (the gate calls view.handle_hover(centre) when the view has it, then draws, and reads the text rows plus view.tooltip_text); and the seven families' whats must be seven different texts (so set_ambition's single shared registry text does not do).

  C10.9: the C9 gate (and through it C1..C8) still passes, run in a fresh interpreter.

work.title: The game starts on the ambition: seven families, pressed, set as a live stake, shown on one House screen
work.text: gilded/ui/app.py: {"menu": "new_game"} (_boot_play_into) lands in play with the House spine's family picker already open — BroadsheetView._ambition_picker = True — so the first screen after New Game draws the seven families of gilded.agenda.FAMILIES as pressable regions ({"set_ambition": {"family": F}, "what": ..., "why": ..., "wins": ...}); a press goes through handle_click -> app._apply_action -> ACTIONS["set_ambition"] -> game.set_ambition(house, F) (the C2 seam that snapshots the stake so ambitions.resolve_due resolves it after 10 turns), closes the picker and opens the Court in Session. The ambition banner (family, target, clock, why) is drawn on ONE House screen — the Court in Session (a House inner page, e.g. "Court", reached from a drawn {"set_spine_page": "Court"} region) — and the family word is drawn nowhere else: the House/Overview ambition button keeps its {"open_ambition_picker": True} region (test_c6c_layout counts it) but its label no longer names the family. gilded/tests/test_c10_ambitions.py asserts the C10.1 measurements exactly as written in measures, including the census.

work.title: Court in Session: portrait cards whose stance and want come from the 30 dispositions, and a lever on every opposing member
work.text: gilded/ambitions.py: AmbitionsFacade.wants(house) computes each adult's stance (backs / wary / opposes) and one-line want from that member's dispositions (the 30 in character.dispositions) against the house ambition — a function of the dispositions and the ambition only, recomputed on every call, so two members with the same vector get the same stance. The Court in Session page (gilded/ui/broadsheet.py or a new gilded/ui/court_view.py drawn by it) draws the banner and at least 4 member cards chosen independently of stance (e.g. the ruler, the seat holders, the eldest): each card is one region {"portrait": member_id} covering the whole card (portrait, name, stance, want — a region over the 48-px portrait alone has no stance row inside it), the name, the stance word from wants() and the want text from wants() (minus the name, wrapped, never truncated), all drawn with blit_text inside the card's rect. Every card whose member opposes carries a lever region {"court_lever": member_id, "what": ..., "why": ..., "wins": ...} (no lever on other members) that, pressed, moves that member off "opposes" in wants() (e.g. pay courtier appeasement gold and move the member's dispositions toward the ambition) — route it in app._apply_action beside set_dial / zoom; do not add keys to the ACTIONS registry (test_ui_actions_i4d2b1 pins it at 46). Every new verb explains itself: what / why / wins in its action dict, wins naming a ladder axis or the ambition, the what AND the why drawn on screen or as the hover hint; the seven family choices each get their own what. The House/Overview section header "INTRIGUE" names the family Intrigue: if the census test you write hits it at a seed whose ambition is Intrigue, rename the header, not the family. test_c10_ambitions.py asserts C10.3, C10.4 and C10.7 as written in measures, including the disposition swap.

work.title: The public ladder on one Powers page, its axes and the rivals' agendas earned through the intel fog
work.text: A Powers inner page (e.g. "Ladder", reached from a drawn {"set_spine_page": "Ladder"} region on the Powers overview) draws every house from game.ladder() as one line "<r>. House <h>" (the player's with "(you)"), and after a rival's entry its four axes "capital N  standing N  blood N  world N" ONLY when gilded.intel.report(game, player, rival).tier == 3 (rank alone below — no axis word with a number on a tier-0/1 house's line anywhere). The HUD stops DRAWING the player's "Rank #<r>", the rival's axis meters and "Their design: ..." (keep hud_model's keys — test_ui_hud_meters asserts the model, not the drawing); no other text — blit_text or any font render() — may state the player's rank (no "#r", "rank r", "4th", "4 of 7", "fourth of seven", "You stand fourth"). The rival agendas keep their one home in the Powers table's Apparent-intent column, which already follows report().tier (family at tier >= 2). The no-ambition screens the committed censuses measure keep their region counts (test_ui_broadsheet EXPECTED_REGIONS; the Governance picker-open census of 21): add new page entrances only where a stake exists, or measure and update nothing. test_c10_ambitions.py asserts C10.2 and C10.5 as written in measures, building the intel states from informants, marriage ties and held secrets.

work.title: The epilogue names the ambition and the outcome the sim resolved
work.text: gilded/endings.py: judge()'s epilogue text opens with (or early carries) one sentence naming the house's ambition family and its outcome as the sim resolved it — game.ambitions.status(house)["fulfilled"]: True -> "was fulfilled", False -> "fell short" — never a pasted word and never read off an axis; the ending page (BroadsheetView._draw_ending_overlay) draws that sentence (it stops drawing paragraphs at the window's bottom, so it must come before the long ones). Keep the ending keys, the four axes and the existing paragraphs (test_endings, test_c7_epilogue). test_c10_ambitions.py asserts C10.6 as written in measures (Glory rich -> fulfilled, Glory broke -> fell short, the outcome equals status()'s).

rules: Clarity Law: state, in test_c10_ambitions.py's module docstring and in the commit message, which spine/inner page owns each new piece of content — the ambition banner and the court cards: the House Court in Session page; the ladder with its fogged axes: one Powers page; the rivals' agendas: the Powers table — and prove nothing else shows it with a test that draws EVERY reachable screen (every spine, every page, every page a drawn set_spine_page region names) and finds the fact on exactly one.

Every new verb carries what it does, why now, and which ladder axis or the ambition it wins, in its action dict (what / why / wins), and its what AND its why are drawn on the screen or as its hover hint.
Headless runs only: SDL_VIDEODRIVER=dummy and SDL_AUDIODRIVER=dummy before importing pygame.

Every graded change is produced by pressing a DRAWN region's centre (handle_click, then app._apply_action) and every drawn fact goes through blit_text (widgets._text_rows) — text rendered with font.render + blit is still on the screen and the gate counts it as a second home or a leak; stances, wants, ranks, axes and agendas are read from the sim (ambitions.wants, game.ladder, intel.report, game.agendas, ambitions.status) at draw time, never cached or pasted.

Keep the committed censuses and controls green: for GildedGame(seed=42) with no ambition, test_ui_broadsheet's EXPECTED_REGIONS House 32 / Powers 19 / Atlas 32 regions and the Governance picker-open census of 21 regions, test_c6c_layout's control groups (one open_ambition_picker on House/Overview), test_c7_history's New Game press, test_ui_hud_meters' hud_model keys, test_ui_actions_i4d2b1's 46 ACTIONS keys.
Do not special-case the disclosed seed; every line is repeated at an undisclosed seed.
Do not weaken, skip or mark any committed test.
Use the CodeIndex tool FIRST for every symbol lookup before any Grep/Read crawl.
